cards_step_terms.name: cards_step_terms
cards_step_terms.value: ("cards"."step" IS NULL) = ("cards"."state"::text = 'review') AND ("cards"."step" IS NULL OR "cards"."step" >= 0)

cards_review_terms.name: cards_review_terms
cards_review_terms.value: num_nulls("cards"."stability", "cards"."difficulty", "cards"."last_review_at", "cards"."last_rating") IN (0, 4) AND ("cards"."last_review_at" IS NOT NULL OR "cards"."state"::text = 'learning')

cards_memory_bounds.name: cards_memory_bounds
cards_memory_bounds.value: ("cards"."stability" IS NULL OR "cards"."stability" > 0) AND ("cards"."difficulty" IS NULL OR "cards"."difficulty" BETWEEN 1 AND 10)

fief_events_one_subject.name: fief_events_one_subject
fief_events_one_subject.value: num_nonnulls("fief_events"."building", "fief_events"."art", "fief_events"."unit", "fief_events"."infantry_count", "fief_events"."fief_name", "fief_events"."lesson_id") = 1 AND ("fief_events"."infantry_count" IS NULL) = ("fief_events"."cavalry_count" IS NULL) AND ("fief_events"."infantry_count" IS NULL) = ("fief_events"."archer_count" IS NULL) AND ("fief_events"."infantry_count" IS NULL) = ("fief_events"."settler_count" IS NULL) AND ("fief_events"."level" IS NULL) = ("fief_events"."building" IS NULL AND "fief_events"."art" IS NULL) AND ("fief_events"."count" IS NULL) = ("fief_events"."unit" IS NULL) AND ("fief_events"."cancelled_count" IS NULL OR ("fief_events"."unit" IS NOT NULL AND "fief_events"."cancelled_count" >= 1)) AND ("fief_events"."province" IS NULL) = ("fief_events"."infantry_count" IS NULL AND "fief_events"."fief_name" IS NULL) AND ("fief_events"."plot" IS NULL) = ("fief_events"."infantry_count" IS NULL AND "fief_events"."fief_name" IS NULL) AND ("fief_events"."province" IS NULL OR ("fief_events"."province" >= 1 AND "fief_events"."plot" >= 1))

fief_events_unit_counts.name: fief_events_unit_counts
fief_events_unit_counts.value: ("fief_events"."infantry_count" IS NOT NULL) = ("fief_events"."kind"::text IN ('march_returned', 'battle_fought')) AND ("fief_events"."infantry_count" IS NULL OR ("fief_events"."infantry_count" >= 0 AND "fief_events"."cavalry_count" >= 0 AND "fief_events"."archer_count" >= 0 AND "fief_events"."settler_count" >= 0)) AND ("fief_events"."kind"::text <> 'march_returned' OR "fief_events"."infantry_count" + "fief_events"."cavalry_count" + "fief_events"."archer_count" + "fief_events"."settler_count" >= 1)

fief_events_battle_terms.name: fief_events_battle_terms
fief_events_battle_terms.value: ("fief_events"."kind"::text = 'battle_fought') = ("fief_events"."camp_tier" IS NOT NULL) AND ("fief_events"."camp_tier" IS NULL) = ("fief_events"."camp_lost" IS NULL) AND ("fief_events"."camp_tier" IS NULL OR ("fief_events"."camp_tier" BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND "fief_events"."camp_lost" >= 0 AND "fief_events"."province" IS NOT NULL)) AND (NOT "fief_events"."won" OR "fief_events"."kind"::text = 'battle_fought')

fief_marches_founding_plot_unique.name: fief_marches_founding_plot_unique
fief_marches_founding_plot_unique.where: "fief_marches"."founding_name" IS NOT NULL AND "fief_marches"."recalled_at" IS NULL

fief_marches_order_terms.name: fief_marches_order_terms
fief_marches_order_terms.value: ("fief_marches"."march_order"::text = 'forage' AND "fief_marches"."stay_hours" >= 1 AND "fief_marches"."camp_tier" IS NULL AND "fief_marches"."camp_strength" IS NULL AND NOT "fief_marches"."fought" AND "fief_marches"."founding_name" IS NULL) OR ("fief_marches"."march_order"::text = 'attack' AND "fief_marches"."stay_hours" = 0 AND "fief_marches"."camp_tier" IS NOT NULL AND "fief_marches"."camp_tier" BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND "fief_marches"."camp_strength" IS NOT NULL AND "fief_marches"."camp_strength" >= 0 AND "fief_marches"."founding_name" IS NULL) OR ("fief_marches"."march_order"::text = 'found' AND "fief_marches"."stay_hours" = 0 AND "fief_marches"."camp_tier" IS NULL AND "fief_marches"."camp_strength" IS NULL AND NOT "fief_marches"."fought" AND "fief_marches"."founding_name" IS NOT NULL AND "fief_marches"."settler_count" = 1 AND "fief_marches"."infantry_count" = 0 AND "fief_marches"."cavalry_count" = 0 AND "fief_marches"."archer_count" = 0) OR ("fief_marches"."march_order"::text = 'transport' AND "fief_marches"."stay_hours" = 0 AND "fief_marches"."camp_tier" IS NULL AND "fief_marches"."camp_strength" IS NULL AND NOT "fief_marches"."fought" AND "fief_marches"."founding_name" IS NULL AND "fief_marches"."settler_count" = 0)

fief_marches_transport_cargo.name: fief_marches_transport_cargo
fief_marches_transport_cargo.value: ("fief_marches"."march_order"::text = 'transport' AND "fief_marches"."to_fief_id" IS NOT NULL AND "fief_marches"."cargo_wood" IS NOT NULL AND "fief_marches"."cargo_stone" IS NOT NULL AND "fief_marches"."cargo_iron" IS NOT NULL AND "fief_marches"."cargo_gold" IS NOT NULL AND "fief_marches"."cargo_food" IS NOT NULL AND "fief_marches"."cargo_wood" + "fief_marches"."cargo_stone" + "fief_marches"."cargo_iron" + "fief_marches"."cargo_gold" + "fief_marches"."cargo_food" >= 1) OR ("fief_marches"."march_order"::text <> 'transport' AND "fief_marches"."to_fief_id" IS NULL AND "fief_marches"."cargo_wood" IS NULL AND "fief_marches"."cargo_stone" IS NULL AND "fief_marches"."cargo_iron" IS NULL AND "fief_marches"."cargo_gold" IS NULL AND "fief_marches"."cargo_food" IS NULL)

review_log_elapsed_days_terms.name: review_log_elapsed_days_terms
review_log_elapsed_days_terms.value: ("review_log"."elapsed_days" IS NULL) = ("review_log"."before_last_review_at" IS NULL) AND ("review_log"."elapsed_days" IS NULL OR "review_log"."elapsed_days" >= 0)

town_events_building_terms.name: town_events_building_terms
town_events_building_terms.value: CASE WHEN "town_events"."kind"::text IN ('building_work_finished', 'building_work_stopped') THEN "town_events"."building" IS NOT NULL AND "town_events"."level" IS NOT NULL AND "town_events"."level" >= 1 ELSE "town_events"."building" IS NULL AND "town_events"."level" IS NULL END

towns_work_slot_terms.name: towns_work_slot_terms
towns_work_slot_terms.value: num_nonnulls("towns"."work_building", "towns"."work_level", "towns"."work_started_at", "towns"."work_finishes_at", "towns"."work_cost_money", "towns"."work_cost_food", "towns"."work_cost_power", "towns"."work_cost_material") = 0 OR (num_nonnulls("towns"."work_building", "towns"."work_level", "towns"."work_started_at", "towns"."work_finishes_at", "towns"."work_cost_money", "towns"."work_cost_food", "towns"."work_cost_power", "towns"."work_cost_material") = 8 AND "towns"."work_level" >= 1 AND "towns"."work_started_at" <= "towns"."work_finishes_at" AND "towns"."work_cost_money" >= 0 AND "towns"."work_cost_money" = trunc("towns"."work_cost_money") AND "towns"."work_cost_food" >= 0 AND "towns"."work_cost_food" = trunc("towns"."work_cost_food") AND "towns"."work_cost_power" >= 0 AND "towns"."work_cost_power" = trunc("towns"."work_cost_power") AND "towns"."work_cost_material" >= 0 AND "towns"."work_cost_material" = trunc("towns"."work_cost_material"))
